gaps.sentence: The two founders hit it ___ immediately.
gaps.explanation: hit it off = like each other and become friendly quickly.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
I bumped ___ my neighbour at the dentist's.
gaps.explanation: bump into somebody = meet by chance.

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: When the alarm sounded, everyone made ___ the nearest exit.
gaps.explanation: 'Make for' = move towards, usually in haste.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
